description: This grouped bar chart illustrates "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" across two model categories under three different training conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories; the left category label is visually blurred and illegible, while the right category is labeled "GPT-4o-mini." The vertical value axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25. The data is organized into grouped bars, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the conditions defined in the top-left legend: "Control" represented by light grey bars, "Before Introspection Training" represented by light blue bars, and "After Introspection Training" represented by dark purple bars. For the first, blurred category, the light grey Control bar has an approximate value of 0.10, the light blue Before Introspection Training bar is near 0.54, and the dark purple After Introspection Training bar is approximately 0.74. For the "GPT-4o-mini" category, the light grey Control bar extends slightly below the zero line to approximately -0.01, making it the lowest value on the chart, while the light blue bar is near 0.51, and the dark purple bar reaches approximately 0.75, representing the tallest value overall. Every bar includes a vertical error bar with caps indicating variability. The bars within each group are ordered consistently from left to right according to the legend, and the categories on the horizontal axis do not appear to follow a specific sorting convention.
